input.subject: Balcony door lock – Flat 20, 110 Meadow Row (ref R/PM023-1)
input.body:
Hello,

Thank you for reporting the lock on the balcony glass door at Flat 20, 110 Meadow Row, Northbridge, ZZ2 5ZZ (ref R/PM023-1). Your landlord has agreed for us to send someone to attend, and we are now arranging a contractor, who will contact you to agree a time.

To help us, please reply with:
- your availability over the next few days for the contractor to attend; and
- whether the balcony can be reached from outside (e.g. ground or first floor, shared or neighbouring balconies), so we can judge how urgently the door needs securing.

In the meantime, please keep the door closed and, if you can, wedge or block it from the inside when you are out or asleep. Don't force the lock, as that can make the repair harder. If you feel the flat is not secure, please call us straight away.

We will update you within one working day.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings
